- Supports drafting documents, process design, requirements analysis, policy development, meeting minutes, and business reporting.
- Features structured workflows: requirement analysis, document generation, process design, report preparation, and more.
- Incorporates best practices and compliance guidance across six major business domains.
- Output standards and templates are included for various document and report types.
- Designed for continuous iteration and easy expansion to cover new business needs and processes.
